metadata.title: PB2002 Plate Model (Bird 2003)
metadata.author: Peter Bird
metadata.citation: Bird, P. (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochem. Geophys. Geosyst., 4(3), 1027, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252.
metadata.notes: 52 plates defined as closed spherical polygon outlines. Forty-nine are topologically identical in NNR-MORVEL56.

plates.name: Africa
plates.description: Major continental plate, incorporates Nubian and Somalian blocks in PB2002

plates.name: Antarctica
plates.description: Major continental/oceanic plate surrounding South Pole

plates.name: Arabia
plates.description: Continental plate moving NNE towards Eurasia

plates.name: Australia
plates.description: Major continental/oceanic plate moving NNE

plates.name: Caribbean
plates.description: Predominantly oceanic/arc plate bordered by subduction and strike-slip faults

plates.name: Cocos
plates.description: Young oceanic plate subducting beneath Central America along Middle America Trench

plates.name: Eurasia
plates.description: Major continental plate covering Europe and northern Asia

plates.name: India
plates.description: Fast-moving continental/oceanic plate colliding with Eurasia (Himalayan orogeny)

plates.name: Juan de Fuca
plates.description: Small oceanic plate subducting beneath Cascadia margin

plates.name: North America
plates.description: Major continental/oceanic plate covering North America and northwest Atlantic

plates.name: Nazca
plates.description: Major oceanic plate subducting beneath western South America (Peru-Chile Trench)

plates.name: Pacific
plates.description: Largest tectonic plate on Earth, entirely oceanic, Ring of Fire boundaries

plates.name: Philippine Sea
plates.description: Oceanic plate surrounded by subduction zones (Izu-Bonin-Mariana, Ryukyu, Philippines)

plates.name: South America
plates.description: Major continental/oceanic plate covering South America and southwest Atlantic

plates.name: Scotia
plates.description: Oceanic microplate between South America and Antarctic Peninsula

plates.name: Amur
plates.description: Continental plate in northeastern Asia (Manchuria, Korea, Primorye)

plates.name: Altiplano
plates.description: High-elevation continental microplate in the central Andes

plates.name: Aegean Sea
plates.description: Extensional continental microplate in eastern Mediterranean

plates.name: Anatolia
plates.description: Continental microplate escaping westward between North and East Anatolian faults

plates.name: Birds Head
plates.description: Microplate in western New Guinea (Vogelkop Peninsula)

plates.name: Balmoral Reef
plates.description: Oceanic microplate in the North Fiji Basin

plates.name: Banda Sea
plates.description: Complex oceanic basin microplate in eastern Indonesia

plates.name: Burma
plates.description: Oblique subduction microplate including Andaman Islands and western Myanmar

plates.name: Caroline
plates.description: Oceanic microplate north of New Guinea, western equatorial Pacific

plates.name: Conway Reef
plates.description: Oceanic microplate southwest of Fiji

plates.name: Easter
plates.description: Rapidly rotating oceanic microplate at the East Pacific Rise

plates.name: Futuna
plates.description: Oceanic microplate near Wallis and Futuna, southwest Pacific

plates.name: Galapagos
plates.description: Oceanic microplate at Cocos-Nazca-Pacific triple junction

plates.name: Juan Fernandez
plates.description: Oceanic microplate at Nazca-Antarctica-Pacific triple junction

plates.name: Kermadec
plates.description: Oceanic trench/arc microplate along Kermadec Ridge

plates.name: Mariana
plates.description: Oceanic back-arc microplate along the Mariana subduction system

plates.name: Manus
plates.description: Ultra-fast rotating oceanic microplate in Bismarck Sea (51 deg/Ma)

plates.name: Maoke
plates.description: Continental mountain microplate in central Irian Jaya (New Guinea)

plates.name: Molucca Sea
plates.description: Complex collision microplate with double subduction zone

plates.name: North Bismarck
plates.description: Oceanic microplate in the Bismarck Sea

plates.name: North Andes
plates.description: Continental block in Colombia and Ecuador between Nazca, Caribbean, and South America

plates.name: New Hebrides
plates.description: Volcanic arc microplate along New Hebrides Trench (Vanuatu)

plates.name: Niuafo'ou
plates.description: Oceanic microplate between Tonga, Samoa, and Lau Basin

plates.name: Okhotsk
plates.description: Continental/island microplate in Sea of Okhotsk, Kamchatka, Sakhalin

plates.name: Okinawa
plates.description: Extensional continental back-arc microplate in the Okinawa Trough

plates.name: Panama
plates.description: Isthmus block between North Andes, Cocos, and Caribbean plates

plates.name: Rivera
plates.description: Small oceanic microplate off Jalisco, Mexico, subducting under North America

plates.name: South Bismarck
plates.description: Oceanic microplate in southern Bismarck Sea (New Britain arc)

plates.name: Shetland
plates.description: Oceanic microplate off Antarctic Peninsula with young active rift

plates.name: Somalia
plates.description: Continental/oceanic plate splitting from Nubia along East African Rift

plates.name: Solomon Sea
plates.description: Small oceanic microplate subducting beneath New Britain and Solomon arcs

plates.name: Sunda
plates.description: Continental/oceanic block including Sunda Shelf, Indochina, Sumatra, Java, Borneo

plates.name: Sandwich
plates.description: Oceanic microplate supporting South Sandwich volcanic arc and trench

plates.name: Timor
plates.description: Forearc microplate along the Timor Trough

plates.name: Tonga
plates.description: Oceanic forearc microplate along Tonga Trench

plates.name: Woodlark
plates.description: Oceanic microplate with young active continental rifting / seafloor spreading

plates.name: Yangtze
plates.description: Continental plate in southern China (South China Craton)
